_about: Direct application links for the @careerwithshrestha posts, found on each company's own site so the app does not send you to Instagram to comment for a DM. Keyed by the job key in shrestha-jobs.json. Only links checked on the company's site (or its official job board) are listed; a job missing here has no verified public link. 'kind': posting = the exact job; search = the company's job search for that role/ID; portal = the company's official fresher-hiring portal. 'fresher': set only when the company's own page shows the opening is for freshers (the evidence, in words) — it counts even when the Instagram caption did not say so. 'closed': the posting has come down on the company's site — the opening is then shown as closed, with no apply button.
